title: Glitch in the Timeline
blurb: Pokémon, Pluto, phones and brand-new discoveries, all scrambled up with older stuff.

cards.say: [Pokémon Go came out in 2016, twenty years after the first Pokémon game], [the Game Boy came out exactly 100 years after Nintendo was founded], [a Pikachu balloon first floated in the Macy's Thanksgiving parade in 2001], and [Mario was already a plumber in his very first game, back in 1981].
cards.real: In his first game, Donkey Kong in 1981, Mario was a carpenter called Jumpman. He became a plumber in Mario Bros. two years later.

cards.say: [Barbie and Ken broke up in 2004 and got back together in 2011], [the Nintendo Switch 2 hit stores in 2023, six years after the first Switch], [a man flew a balloon all the way around the world in 11 days in 2016], and [Pikachu was one of Japan's mascots for the 2014 World Cup].
cards.real: The Nintendo Switch 2 came out on June 5, 2025, eight years after the first Switch.

cards.say: [Scientists officially renamed Pluto a dwarf planet in 2016], [Disney's cartoon dog Pluto was first called Rover], [in 2025, scientists announced the oldest ant fossil ever found], and [in 2011, Neptune finished its first lap around the Sun since being discovered].
cards.real: Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in August 2006.

cards.say: [The first cell phone call ever was made to a worker at a rival company], [the first cell phone weighed about two and a half pounds], [when cell phones first went on sale, they cost about 400 dollars], and [in 2020, NASA sent a brand-new toilet up to the space station].
cards.real: When cell phones first went on sale in 1983, they cost about 3,500 to 4,000 dollars.

cards.say: [Pokémon Go got 130 million downloads in its very first month], [Mario got his mustache because early game screens couldn't show a mouth well], [Nintendo stopped making playing cards back in the 1970s], and [in 2012, a survey found the Great Wall of China is over 21,000 kilometers long].
cards.real: Nintendo kept making cards. In 2007 it even sold hanafuda playing cards with Mario on them.

cards.say: [In 2007, the Great Pyramid was voted one of the New Seven Wonders of the World], [the first coin-operated arcade video games showed up in 1971], [the Nintendo Switch came out more than 10 years after the Wii], and [Tetris came packed with the Game Boy everywhere except Japan].
cards.real: The Great Pyramid wasn't one of the seven winners in 2007. It was given an honorary spot instead.

cards.say: [New Horizons flew for about nine and a half years to reach Pluto in 2015], [scientists found out that Pluto has blue skies, a bit like Earth's], [Pikachu's name mixes a sparkly sound with a mouse's squeak], and [tiny water bears called tardigrades rode a spacecraft to the Moon in 2007].
cards.real: In 2007 the tardigrades rode a satellite that circled close to Earth, nowhere near the Moon.

cards.say: [Barbie's official birthday is March 9, 1959], [two Barbie dolls blasted off to visit the Moon in 2022], [the first cell phone could only talk for about 35 minutes on one charge], and [in 2021, tree rings proved Vikings were in Canada in the year 1021].
cards.real: In 2022 the two Barbie dolls toured the International Space Station, which circles Earth, not the Moon.

cards.say: [Pikachu, created in 1996, was designed by the same man who created Mario], [Pong came out the same year as the first home video game console], [The Super Mario Bros. Movie came out in April 2023], and [a hot air balloon flew across the Pacific Ocean in 1991].
cards.real: Pikachu was drawn by Atsuko Nishida, and Ken Sugimori finished the design. Mario was created by Shigeru Miyamoto.

cards.say: [Pokémon games didn't reach the rest of the world until 1998], [Nintendo sold a toy grabber called the Ultra Hand before it made video games], [Nintendo's first home video game, from 1977, was a Pong-style game], and [Pokémon Go came out in Japan first, before anywhere else in the world].
cards.real: Pokémon Go launched first in Australia, New Zealand and the United States on July 6, 2016. Japan got it later.

cards.say: [Mario and Donkey Kong first showed up in the same video game], [basketball's handwritten first rules sold for about 43,000 dollars in 2010], [people at MIT made a space video game called Spacewar in 1962], and [Princess Peach first became a character you could play in 1988].
cards.real: James Naismith's original basketball rules sold at an auction in 2010 for 4.3 million dollars.

cards.say: [In Italian, the @ sign has a cute nickname: the snail], [China's first astronaut said he couldn't see the Great Wall from space], [Steve Fossett flew a balloon solo around the world on his very first try], and [a Japanese airline painted Pikachu on jumbo jets in 1998].
cards.real: Steve Fossett made it around the world alone in 2002, but only on his sixth try.
